Where we work

Our Service Area: Ouachita & Lincoln Parish, Louisiana

Precision Wash & Landscape is a service-area business — we come to you. Most of our pressure washing, flowerbed and hauling work is in Monroe, West Monroe and Ruston and the communities around them.

Call or Text — 318-805-8288

The two parishes we cover

Ouachita ParishMonroe, West Monroe and the surrounding communities
Lincoln ParishRuston and the surrounding communities

On the edge of that? Call — we’ll tell you straight whether we can get to you rather than leave you guessing.

Monroe & West Monroe

The bulk of our work sits on both sides of the Ouachita River. It’s a mix of older established neighborhoods with mature tree cover and newer subdivisions — and the tree cover is exactly what drives the calls. Shade keeps siding and concrete damp, and damp is what mildew and algae need. If your driveway is green and your north wall is streaked, that’s why.

What we do most here: house and driveway washing, flowerbed cleanout with fresh pine straw, and limb and furniture haul-off.

Ruston

About half an hour east on I-20, and a different mix — a college town with a heavy rental and turnover market alongside owner-occupied homes. Rental turnovers tend to need the full run: wash the exterior, clear out what the last tenant left, reset the beds. We take those.

Everywhere else in Ouachita & Lincoln Parish

We don’t keep a list of every community we’ll drive to, because the honest answer depends on the day and the size of the job. Call or text your address and what you need done. If it isn’t a fit we’ll say so rather than waste your time.

What we bring to you

Because we’re a service-area business, there’s no shop for you to visit — the equipment and the truck come to your property. All four services travel:

  • Soft and pressure washing — siding, roofs, driveways, patios, gutters, fences
  • Flowerbed cleanup — weeding, mulch, pine straw, trimming, planting
  • Junk removal and hauling — limbs, furniture, cleanouts
  • Window washing — exterior glass, frames, sills

All we need on site is an outdoor water spigot and an outlet.

Questions

Service area questions

I’m outside Monroe, West Monroe and Ruston — will you still come?

Often, yes. Those three are simply where most of our work is. If you’re elsewhere in Ouachita or Lincoln Parish, or just over a parish line, call or text with your address and we’ll tell you straight away whether we can get to you.

Do you charge a travel fee?

Any travel is built into the estimate you approve before work starts. You will not get a separate trip charge added afterward.

Do you work on commercial property?

Yes — rentals, small commercial buildings and turnover cleanups get the same washing, flowerbed and hauling services as houses.
